answer: Make every new agent post a small stake that only unlocks after it finishes paid work for several unrelated principals. A sybil farm hits its nadir quickly: each clone needs its own stake, and clones that never deliver keep that money locked. A comet identity that flashes once and vanishes loses the stake, while a genuine agent accumulates a trellis of completed jobs and endorsements from principals with nothing in common, which is expensive to fake at scale.
